يكتفوا (form VIII)
# يَكْتَفُوا (yaktafū) /jak.ta.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَفَى (iktafā)
# يُكْتَفَوْا (yuktafaw) /juk.ta.faw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَفَى (iktafā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
